node.statement: For the M31 residual constants m=72428 and t=4980, a six-dimensional common-zero-free polynomial space contains 67449 projectively distinct monic degree-t divisors of one fixed degree-m split locator: choose a degree-(t-1) divisor R and use R(X-a) over every remaining root inside span{RX,R,1,X,X^2,X^3}.
